CMR.note: The document states nothing on rules, hosting or contract terms for state data; sovereignty is mentioned only in general.
The document names no international fibre route or cable landing for Cameroon.

facts.fact: The article says Cameroon decreed a ban on Starlink in April 2024 for national security reasons and lack of a local licence, that SpaceX suspended its service in the country, and that customs at Ekok seized 29 kits in early 2026.
